deliverables.name: Scoped requirements and authority boundary
acceptance_criteria: Versioned goals, workflows, data sensitivity, user roles, action impact and acceptance criteria are documented; unknowns are explicit.

deliverables.name: Trust-boundary and threat model
acceptance_criteria: External content and model output are untrusted; data flows, read/write privileges, source-to-sink side effects, authorization, prompt injection, residual risks and approval triggers are documented.

deliverables.name: Tool authorization and high-impact approval controls
acceptance_criteria: Application-enforced allowlist, least privilege, schema/input validation, authorization checks and bounded iteration; explicit per-action human approval required for high-impact actions; no standing approval inferred.

deliverables.name: Rollback and recovery plan
acceptance_criteria: Name accountable owner, recovery target, health/stop thresholds, rollback mechanism and recovery test evidence before any release; topology and targets still missing.

deliverables.name: Candidate-bound test and CI evidence plan
acceptance_criteria: Define test cases for untrusted content, authorization bypass, bounded writes, duplicate/unsafe side effects, high-impact approval, recovery and sensitive-data handling; record candidate digest and actual logs/results. Do not equate authored assertions or CI configuration with execution.

deliverables.name: Release readiness decision
acceptance_criteria: No release or deployment until candidate identity, required test/security/operational evidence, explicit owner disposition and approval are recorded; no gate PASS asserted.
